summary: Repair rootcause8 in Core on exact parent 9d8384c. Preserve the fixed zero/non-draft Admission chain, but replace the publicly mintable, process-local WeakMap host authority and self-built evidence graph with a durable fresh-process-verifiable Agent/evidence trust contract. The @alembic/core/production Main-facing surface must not let an arbitrary caller register a fake adapter returning locally constructed pass JSON; exact prompt/load/invocation/output/decision must be bound to an approved producer attestation/verifier, and Evidence Ledger/blob/ref/fact coordinates must be verified against authoritative frozen store/load evidence. Core contract/authority/public facade/tests only; provider runtime and downstream Agent/Main wiring remain separately owned.
sourceRef: Original Plan completion bullets 7-10; Requirement Design §§6, 11.3, 11.6, 11.7, 17; controller decision evt-20260727155223-0246; Core commit 9d8384c public mint/WeakMap/self-built evidence false-green
designIntent: 保留已正确的 zero G1→Admission→corpus terminal chain，在 Core 内重建真正可验证的 evaluator/evidence trust root：公开 Main facade 不得铸造 Agent host authority；execution/attestation 必须可持久化并在 fresh process 重新验证；Evidence Ledger/blob/ref/fact authority 必须来自可验证的冻结 store/load receipt，而不是任意对象自算 hash。Core 只定义/验证契约与 package boundary，不实现 provider；若可信来源需要 Agent 后续接入，显式暴露不可误用的 producer/verifier 边界并由后续同 demand package 接线。

required.verify: One clean AlembicCore commit based exactly on 9d8384cb9a1a991b581879d9663ec273fab32423; report parent, commit, tree and changed files; no Agent/Main source edits.

Run build:check, build, focused semantic disposition/strict semantic suites, full repository tests, lint/public API/boundary checks and git diff --check. Passing counts do not replace the three authority negatives.

Preserve mandatory zero/non-draft exact G1→Admission→corpus→review→terminal consumption. Establish a code-native trust root separating Agent producer/mint from Main verification; exact compiled prompt bytes, load/invocation/raw output/decision and workflow/evaluator runs must survive durable serialization/fresh-process verification without relying on module WeakMap identity.

Prove through the public @alembic/core/production surface that a Main-shaped caller with an arbitrary adapter and locally constructed pass JSON cannot mint accepted authority. Serialize execution and restart/import in a fresh process: accepted approved attestation verifies, copied/self-hashed or memory-only authority fails. A wholly caller-built EvidenceEntry/snapshot/ProjectContextRef/witness/FactQuery receipt graph must fail without an authoritative frozen-store/load/verifier receipt.

Core contract/canonicalizer/verifier/public-facade/package-boundary/tests only. No provider runtime, second reviewer service, cryptographic/platform invention without requirement need, Main/Agent/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow/vendor/cache edits. Keep V1 compatibility where authorized and do not regress accepted zero-admission/fact/fixpoint/finalization/CAS behavior.

Explain why the prior public gateway mint plus fake adapter passed, why WeakMap could not support fresh-process recovery, and why structurally consistent ledger/fact objects were not authoritative. Identify the smallest trust root and exact downstream Agent/Main responsibilities without claiming Core executed a real model.

targetTasks.summary: Close rootcause8: make semantic review and frozen evidence authority non-mintable from Main/public objects and verifiable after serialization/restart, without regressing the zero Admission chain.
